title: Energy Discontinuity of the Lyapunov Exponent for Quasiperiodic Schrödinger Operators with Gevrey Potentials
summary: We construct quasiperiodic Schrödinger operators with Gevrey potentials for which the Lyapunov exponent is discontinuous in the spectral energy. More precisely, let \(α\in\R\setminus\mathbb Q\) satisfy the Diophantine condition \(\|kα\|_{\T}\geqγ|k|^{-τ}\) for all \(k\in\Z\setminus\{0\}\), with \(γ>0\) and \(τ\geq1\).
